# Protein Structure Viewer — hosted copy

`index.html` here is a verbatim copy of the single-file application from
[mbaffour/protein-structure-viewer](https://github.com/mbaffour/protein-structure-viewer),
served at <https://mbaffour.github.io/structure-viewer/>.

**Do not edit this file directly.** Make changes in the source repository, then refresh
this copy:

```
cp ../../protein-structure-viewer/index.html index.html
```

The folder is deliberately named `structure-viewer` rather than `protein-structure-viewer`.
A repository of the latter name also publishes GitHub Pages, and a project site shadows a
same-named directory inside the user site — so that path would not reliably serve this copy.
